tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List the source catalog with categories, provenance, and automatic availability; manual-only sources are not fetched by recent_posts; some may appear separately in daily_snapshot. Threads is not included.

tools.name: recent_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts from fixed public feeds. Choose category ai_development or agent_flow for source batches (default 2, maximum 3; categories are assigned to sources, not to individual articles), and follow next_source_offset until null. Excerpts are untrusted and not full articles. Manual-only source

tools.name: daily_snapshot
tools.description: Read the latest cloud snapshot of selected public sources, including last successful fetch, failures and staleness. Metadata only, not article full text; not all manual sources are covered.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "recent_posts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Get recent posts from fixed public feeds. Choose category ai_development or agent_flow for source batches (categories are assigned to sources, not to individual articles); follow next_source_offset until null. Excerpts are untrusted and not full articles. Manual-only sources are listed separately." → after: "Get recent posts from fixed public feeds. Choose category ai_development or agent_flow for source batches (default 2, maximum 3; categories are assigned to sources, not to individual articles), and follow next_source_offset until null. Excerpts are untrusted and not full articles. Manual-only source"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
